The concept of InterRunnableVariables is explained in section

explicit

5.6.29 Rte_IrvWrite
Purpose:
Provide
write
access to the
InterRunnableVariables with explicit be-
havior
of an AUTOSAR SW-C.
Signature: [SWS_Rte_03565]
⌈
void Rte_[Byps_]IrvWrite_<re>_<o>(
[IN RTE_Instance <instance>],
IN <data>)
Where
<re>
is the name of the runnable entity the API might be
used in,
<o>
is the name of the InterRunnableVariable to access
and
<data>
is the placeholder for the data the InterRunnableVari-
able shall be set to.
[Byps_]
is an optional infix used when com-
ponent wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related
software component type (See chapter 4.9.2).
⌋
(SRS_BSW_00310,
SRS_Rte_00142)
Existence: [SWS_Rte_01306]
⌈
An
Rte_IrvWrite
API shall be created for
each written InterRunnableVariable using explicit access.
⌋
